not_one_taxpayer.text:
Since individual records in this file may or may not contain data from just one tax return--
and never contain the full item content of any one tax return-- we request that researchers make 
these facts clear in publishing their findings.  In particular, they should refrain from using any 
language that would imply that they had access to individual taxpayers' records.

not_selected_reasons.amount_field_outside_this_increment: A publisher amount field that this bounded increment does not project. It stays source-only: no unit, sign or period claim is made about it here, and nothing downstream may treat its absence from the projection as a statement about its value.
not_selected_reasons.code_field_not_an_amount: The publisher's CORE RECORD LAYOUT lists this name under 'Code Fields'. It is a code, a count or an indicator, never a dollar amount.
not_selected_reasons.misc_code_not_an_amount: The publisher's own 'Misc Codes' block sits inside the amount-field list and holds a return identifier, a weight with implied decimals, two sample counts, a sample code and a marginal tax rate with an implied decimal point. Membership of the amount list is therefore not evidence that a column is money.

notable_source_only.E00100: Adjusted gross income (deficit). The reviewed growth slice already retains source-year AGI as provenance; projecting it here would create a second, competing source of the same quantity.
notable_source_only.E01100: Capital gain distributions reported on Form 1040. A capital-gains component this increment does not project, because no publisher statement composes it with E01000, P22250 or P23250.
notable_source_only.E01400: Taxable IRA distribution. Retirement-adjacent but a distinct publisher concept from pensions and annuities; not projected here.
notable_source_only.E02000: Schedule E net income or loss. Business-adjacent but a different publisher concept from Schedule C; not projected here.
notable_source_only.E02400: Gross Social Security benefits. Not projected in this increment.
notable_source_only.E05800: Income tax before credits: the publisher's own before-credits quantity, and the reason E06500 must not be read as one.
notable_source_only.E06500: Total income tax. A tax outcome of 2015 law applied to 2015 amounts. Aging it would not compute any later year's policy, and the archived SOI measure table binds this same code to both 'total income tax' and 'income tax before credits', a conflict a successor must settle. It stays source-year evidence.
notable_source_only.E08800: Income tax after credits (SOI). A tax outcome; source-only.
notable_source_only.E10300: Total tax liability (SOI). A tax outcome; source-only.
notable_source_only.E22320: Long term gain/loss from other forms on Schedule D. See E01100.
notable_source_only.E22370: Schedule D capital gain distributions. See E01100.
notable_source_only.E25920: Partnership total passive loss specifically, not a generic gross loss. The archived code path consumed this code without ever describing it; the label alone establishes no blank or negative decoder, so it stays source-only.
notable_source_only.E26270: Combined partnership and S corporation net income/loss. Not projected; the archived producer both sign-branched and AGI-fallback aged this code, which double-counted it.
notable_source_only.E27200: Farm rent net income or loss. A separate publisher row from the Schedule F farm result; not projected here.
notable_source_only.E30400: The record-layout row says 'primary taxpayer', but the publisher's own definition on the same booklet's detailed pages says the combined primary and secondary net earnings from self-employment *subject to Social Security tax*. The label and the definition disagree, and the definition governs. See the refused uncapped-SE derivation.
notable_source_only.E30500: The secondary taxpayer's capped amount. See E30400 and the refused uncapped-SE derivation.

layout.prefix_is_not_evidence: No column's role is inferred from an E, P, S or T prefix or from membership of the amount-field list. RECID, S006, S008, S009, WSAMP and TXRT are inside that list and none is money; TXRT carries an implied decimal point.

projection.row_policy: every delivered main record is projected, including the 88,021 with no demographic row and the four disclosure aggregates

raw_source_definition.relationship: This document extends the reviewed raw source definition. It restates none of that document's pins as its own authority and never modifies it; the artifact binds both.

uncapped_self_employment_earnings.reason: E30400 is the combined primary and secondary net earnings from self-employment *subject to Social Security tax* — the lesser of net Schedule SE earnings and the maximum amount subject to the tax — and E30500 is the secondary taxpayer's own capped amount. Subtracting one from the other yields a capped primary residual, not uncapped self-employment earnings, and grossing the difference up cannot recover what the cap removed.

E22250.reason: The archived producer's screened-field handling and several downstream discussions treat E22250 and P22250 as one column. The delivered header carries P22250 only, and neither booklet prints E22250 anywhere. Normalising one onto the other would be a guess, so a declaration or a delivered header naming E22250 is a refusal instead.

record_count_includes_header.statement: The technical description says 207,696 CSV records with the first record containing field names, implying 207,695 data records. The accepted raw-byte audit observed 207,696 data records plus a header. Preserve the measured count without silently reconciling this wording conflict.

rounding_five_dollar_tie.statement: The nearest-ten-dollar rule does not state how a five-dollar tie is resolved. A delivered zero does not identify reported zero, absence, nonapplicability or another edit.
